question: Which of the following was the objective of the law enacted in 1856 in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Legalising widow remarriage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act** was enacted in **1856** during the British colonial rule in India.
 
• The primary objective of the law was to **legalize the remarriage of Hindu widows**, which was previously considered a social taboo and was prohibited in many communities.
 
• This law aimed to improve the social status and well-being of widows, who were often subjected to ill-treatment and societal discrimination in traditional Indian society.
